text: Confidential presentation from the Collective Bargaining Team respecting Collective Bargaining City of Toronto, CUPE Local 79, TCEU Local 416 and CUPE Local 2998.

The Labour Relations Subcommittee: 1. Adopted the confidential instructions to staff in the confidential presentation (October 21, 2024) from the Executive Director, Employee Relations. 2. Directed that the confidential presentation (October 21, 2024) from the Executive Director, Employee Relations remain confidential in its entirety as it pertains to labour relations or employee negotiations.
